scope: A focused Frontier-login-side serial-host regression exercises the paper_mhd_pic coupled MHD background, coupled feedback, cell-centered current deposition, conservative momentum and energy feedback, supported x1 reflect particle and moment boundaries, supported x2 outflow moment boundaries, adaptive refine/derefine reconstruction, and restart continuation in one bounded path. Alternating dens_max overrides force three refine and three derefine transitions through five restart continuations. This is development evidence only, not a registered Frontier compute-node run or scientific AMR qualification.
